summary.headline: Privi Q2 FY27 revenue rose 13.9% to INR773.16 crore and EBITDA 16.7% to INR212.49 crore, with a 27.48% EBITDA margin and first-ever interim dividend of INR5 per share.
summary.overview: Management reported record quarterly total income of INR773.16 crore (up 13.9% YoY), EBITDA of INR212.49 crore (up 16.66%) and PAT of INR117.03 crore (up 24.61%). H1 PAT was INR201 crore, up about 29%. Phase 1 capacity expansion (48,000 to 54,000 MTPA) was completed as of 30 September 2026, with Phase 2 and Phase 3 capex still in progress. Management reiterated 20% annual growth and a path to INR5,000 crore revenue by 2030, but H1 volume growth was only about 7-7.5% and Q2 volume growth about 4%.

segments.name: PRIGIV (JV with Jeevadan)
segments.commentary: Q2 FY27 sales about INR28 crore with PBT close to INR2 crore; H1 sales about INR47 crore with negligible loss of about INR0.02 lakh. Management guided JV revenue of about INR225 crore for FY27-28 from two expansion phases; a third phase is in pilot.

segments.name: Privi Fine Sciences / Privi Biotechnology (merger pending)
segments.commentary: FY26 turnover about INR68 crore with loss of about INR34 crore. Capacity of about 6,000 MTPA is in place but utilisation is held back by pending regulatory and pollution board approvals; management sees potential revenue of INR300-350 crore at full utilisation.

guidance_outlook: Management maintains 20% growth guidance for FY27 on an annual basis, despite H1 growth of about 15%; it expects H2 to be stronger than H1.
FY27-28 revenue expected close to INR3,750-4,000 crore with 20% growth maintained or exceeded; EBITDA margin to be held at current levels.

Phase 2 (furfural-based derivatives: maltol, ethyl maltol, cyclopentanone and specialty molecules, about 12,000 MTPA) to be completed June-September 2027, with revenue from October 2027; target about INR1,000 crore revenue at full capacity.
Phase 3 capex of INR400-425 crore expected to add about INR450-500 crore revenue; all three phases targeted to deliver about INR1,900 crore incremental revenue by 2030.
Incentive receipts of about INR12-15 crore expected over the next two quarters, versus INR9 crore last year.
Long-term working capital cycle guided at 105-110 days on an annual basis.
Q4 volume growth expected as annual contracts start, with 85-90% utilisation on expanded capacity.
capex_capacity: Phase 1 completed as of 30 September 2026, raising installed capacity from 48,000 to 54,000 MTPA (+6,000 MTPA). Part of the debottlenecking volume comes in Q3 and the bulk in Q4 FY27.
Overall utilisation of plants around 85-90% per management.
Total capex across three phases about INR1,400 crore; about INR1,000 crore still to be spent on Phase 2 and Phase 3.
Phase 2 expected to be completed June-September 2027, with trial production and commercial sales from H2 FY28.
Asset turnover on fixed asset base at 1.7x; management expects further improvement with Phase 2 and 3 molecules.
PRIGIV capacity expansion underway in two phases; a third phase is being evaluated through pilot studies with guidance to follow in 3-6 months.
demand_pricing: Management says aroma chemical usage is rising, citing new applications for pinene and African market growth through customers, but gave no segment-level growth guidance.
Freight: contracts now include quarterly freight pricing pass-through mechanism; management says freight disruption has been less severe for Privi than peers.

Raw materials: about 70% of revenue from non-petroleum feedstock; management sees no significant impact from West Asia conflict. Procurement of CST/GTO imports reported as diversified with no supply constraints.
RMC (raw material cost) at about 52% of sales in Q2 FY27, vs 54% in Q1 FY27 and 51% in Q2 FY26; expenses at 9.72% of sales.
Customer response to next-year contracts described as positive; first customer indications point to higher purchases, but no specifics were disclosed.
Q2 volume growth about 4% YoY; H1 volume growth about 7-7.5% YoY, with the balance of revenue growth from price/mix.

qa_highlights.question: Has the debottlenecking capacity commissioned by September 2026 started ramping, and what is utilisation?
qa_highlights.answer: Sanjeev Patil said expansion is complete, with part of volumes in Q3 and most in Q4 when annual contracts start; utilisation on expanded capacity is expected at 85-90%.

qa_highlights.question: Does management still hold 20% growth guidance when H1 grew about 15%?
qa_highlights.answer: Narayan Iyer confirmed 20% annual growth guidance, saying H1 is normally lower than H2 and investors should look at yearly numbers.

qa_highlights.question: Why did EBITDA margin look flat ex-other income, and when were incentives received?
qa_highlights.answer: Iyer said incentives were INR1.62 crore in H1 FY27 vs INR9 crore last year, with INR12-15 crore expected in the next two quarters; margin held because fixed costs were spread over a larger base and RMC was about 52%.

qa_highlights.question: Why is other income high in Q1 and Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: Iyer said it is mainly forex gains, as Privi is a net exporter and the dollar has favoured it.

qa_highlights.question: Why is working capital trending down, and what is the long-term level?
qa_highlights.answer: Iyer said customers pay on time or early; cycle is below 100 days now and the long-term annual range is 105-110 days.

qa_highlights.question: What is the status of the Privi Fine Sciences merger and its utilisation?
qa_highlights.answer: Sanjeev Patil said regulatory approvals are nearing completion; management expects the merger before FY-end. Utilisation is about 85%, but the expansion awaits pollution board permissions, and management expects revenue to rise from about INR100 crore toward INR250-300 crore.

qa_highlights.question: What revenue will the Phase 1-3 capex generate?
qa_highlights.answer: Iyer said Phase 2 could deliver about INR1,000 crore at full 12,000 MTPA capacity, Phase 3 (INR400-425 crore capex) about INR450-500 crore, with total about INR1,900 crore by 2030.

risks_watch: H1 volume growth of about 7-7.5% and Q2 volume growth of about 4% sit well below the 20% annual guidance; H2 must deliver a sharp acceleration.
Phase 2 and 3 timelines (June-September 2027 completion, about INR1,000 crore spend) depend on execution; capex is still largely ahead.
Privi Fine Sciences / Privi Biotechnology (merger, 6,000 MTPA plant) remains loss-making at about INR34 crore loss in FY26 and depends on pending pollution board and regulatory permissions.
PRIGIV deleveraging (debt conversion to advance with multinational partners) is in process but has no timeline.
Q2 margin benefited from the prior-year INR9 crore incentive base and forex gains in other income; underlying margin gains are harder to isolate.
Two strategic JV agreements remain unsigned; management gave no timeline.
Freight and geopolitical exposure; management says limited impact, but freight is passed through on a quarterly basis with a lag.
summary.management_tone: Confident on headline numbers and the 20% growth target, but guarded on specifics: management declined segment guidance, customer details and JV deal timing. It answered several questions with reassurance rather than data, notably on volume growth, the Privi Fine Sciences merger and the unsigned JV agreements.
key_quotes: I'm pleased to share that we have delivered our strongest ever quarterly performance, notwithstanding very adverse global headwinds.
We are confident of maintaining 20% or beating 20%, be honest.
Our working capital cycle has also come down to less than 100 days during this quarter from the 124 days, which we achieved in the same period in the previous year.
No, as you can understand, this is a bit proprietary. So, I'll be very guarded in terms of what I'm saying.

adds.what: Phase 1 debottlenecking: installed capacity 48,000 to 54,000 MTPA (+6,000 MTPA), completed 30 Sep 2026; bulk of volume in Q4 FY27
Phase 2 furfural-based derivatives (~12,000 MTPA; maltol, ethyl maltol, cyclopentanone), targeted ~INR1,000 crore revenue at full capacity
Phase 3 capex of INR400-425 crore adding ~INR450-500 crore revenue

growth.why: Management maintains 20% annual growth for FY27 and FY27-28 revenue of INR3,750-4,000 crore, but H1 growth was ~15% with H1 volume only ~7-7.5% (Q2 ~4%), so the balance is price/mix; Phase 1 (+6,000 MTPA, 12.5% of 48,000 MTPA) is live and Phase 2 (~12,000 MTPA, slipped to H2 FY28) and Phase 3 (INR400-425 crore) are still under way, giving partial backing.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management says it can hold the current EBITDA margin (27.48% in Q2), with INR12-15 crore of incentives expected over the next two quarters vs INR9 crore last year, but RMC at about 52% and forex-driven other income make underlying expansion hard to isolate, so this is maintenance rather than expansion.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Phase 1 debottlenecking (48,000 to 54,000 MTPA, +12.5%) was completed 30 Sep 2026, with part of the volume in Q3 and the bulk in Q4 FY27; Phase 2 (~12,000 MTPA) is due June-September 2027 with revenue from October 2027.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: H1 volume grew only about 7-7.5% and Q2 about 4%, but management expects Q4 volume growth as annual contracts start and utilisation on expanded capacity reaches 85-90%; the balance of revenue growth is price/mix.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Utilisation is about 85-90% across plants, and about INR1,000 crore of the INR1,400 crore three-phase capex is still to be spent on Phase 2 and Phase 3, with Phase 3 (INR400-425 crore) planned, so new commitments are likely to be announced or formalised.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management kept 20% annual growth guidance despite H1 growth of about 15% and volume growth of only 7-7.5%, so an upgrade is not signalled and H2 must accelerate just to meet the existing target.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: H1 revenue growth of about 15% and volume growth of about 7-7.5% sit well below the 20% annual target, requiring a sharp H2 acceleration, and Phase 2 has slipped to H2 FY28 revenue.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Phase 2 furfural-based derivatives (maltol, ethyl maltol, cyclopentanone, ~12,000 MTPA) target about INR1,000 crore revenue at full capacity from October 2027, and the PRIGIV third phase is in pilot.

rows.label: Privi Fine Sciences merger and 6,000 MTPA plant utilisation
rows.why: Management expects the merger before FY-end and revenue to rise from about INR68 crore (FY26) toward INR250-300 crore, but the plant is loss-making (INR34 crore FY26 loss) and expansion awaits pollution board permissions.

rows.label: Working capital cycle normalisation to 105-110 days
rows.why: Cycle fell from 124 days to below 100 days, and management guides to 105-110 days on an annual basis, so some cash release may reverse.

rows.label: Two strategic JV agreements and PRIGIV deleveraging
rows.why: Two JV agreements remain unsigned and PRIGIV's debt-to-equity conversion is in process with no timeline, while PRIGIV revenue is guided at about INR225 crore for FY27-28.
